entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • C# compiler crashes when a program uses a checked operator on a generic type that has been defined in a library project as a constrained extension. #82977

PullRequests

Created

  • Modify TextLine.End to no longer be computed. #82978
    Area-IDE
  • Don't format plain blocks as member declaration blocks in top level code #82976
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged
